name: Chiikawa
description: The story follows the sometimes happy, sometimes sad, and a tad stressful daily life of "some sort of small, cute creature" (Nanka Chiisakute Kawaii Yatsu) known as Chiikawa. Chiikawa enjoys delicious food with bees and rabbits, toils hard every day for the rewards of work, and still maintains a smile.

videos.title: Santa Tell Me
videos.overview: A collaboration between Chiikawa and Ariana Grande featuring her song Santa Tell Me.
